Ed Sheeran Tour Disrupted by Support Acts' Withdrawal Over Macklemore's Remarks

Ed Sheeran's North and South American tour has faced disruption after four opening acts withdrew from the lineup. The withdrawals occurred in solidarity with rapper Macklemore, who was reportedly removed from the tour. Macklemore's removal followed his on-stage pro-Palestinian comments. The situation has been described as a crisis for the tour.
